app.name: Hoardex
app.tagline: Your Steam library, at a glance.

entry.label: Steam profile
entry.placeholder: Profile URL, custom name or SteamID64
entry.invalid: That does not look like a Steam profile. Try a profile URL, a custom name or a SteamID64.
entry.hint: The profile and its game details must be public.

notFound.title: Profile not found
notFound.body: We could not find that Steam profile. Check the URL, custom name or SteamID64.

profilePrivate.title: This profile is private
profilePrivate.body: The owner has to make the profile public before it can be shown here.

libraryPrivate.title: The game library is private
libraryPrivate.body: The profile is public but its game details are not. The owner can change that in their Steam privacy settings.

wishlistPrivate.title: The wishlist is private
wishlistPrivate.body: The owner has to make the wishlist public before it can be shown here.

rateLimited.title: Steam is busy
rateLimited.body: Steam is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.

upstream.title: Something went wrong
upstream.body: We could not reach Steam or got an unexpected answer. Try again in a moment.
